articles.title: Lending protocol Bonzo loses 77% of value locked as $9 million oracle exploit rattles Hedera
articles.snippet: Bonzo Lend lost approximately $9.05 million after an attacker exploited a verification flaw in a third-party Supra oracle contract on the Hedera network.

articles.title: AI found an Ethereum bug that could take validators offline, but humans had to prove it
articles.snippet: The Ethereum Foundation pointed coordinated AI agents at the software its validators run and got a remotely triggerable crash out of it. It also got a pile of confident, well-written findings that were not bugs at all.

articles.title: Hackers tried to backdoor Injective NPM package to steal wallet keys
articles.snippet: Injective said the security vulnerability was patched up immediately and claims there were no downloads of the malicious package.

articles.title: MoonPay Brings Its AI Crypto Agents to Telegram
articles.snippet: MoonAgents lets users analyze markets and prepare crypto transactions through Telegram while keeping keys on their own devices.
